title: 宝塚記念の後に・恐れぬ者は斯く語り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Inari One confronts Yaeno Muteki and accuses her of holding back, but Yaeno claims she gave it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno asks me if I also think that she's not giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I admit that I feel the same and that it might have something to do with how she tames her blaze fierce with water still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she stops holding herself back, she could add a powerful weapon to her arsenal. But it would come with the risk of her being overwhelmed by her emotions and losing control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki grows quiet. After a while, she says she'd like to think it over while training for the upcoming autumn Tenno Sho.
